transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I've been feeling extremely down and depressed, and I've completely lost interest in almost everything I used to enjoy. It has been going on like this for nearly two years now, about a year and eleven months to be exact.
Have you had any period of at least two months during these nearly two years when you felt significantly better or back to your usual self?
No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been constant for the entire year and eleven months, without any periods of feeling better or like my normal self.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports a continuous depressed mood and loss of interest for nearly two years with no symptom-free period of at least two months. That chronic duration pattern fits Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely, since MDD is typically episodic rather than continuously present over this length of time.
